name: OVC CaseFile
install: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-runtime.txt && cd ../frontend && yarn install
start: cd backend && .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate --noinput && .venv/bin/python manage.py seed_data

terminals.name: Preview
terminals.command: test -f frontend/build/index.html || (cd frontend && CI=false yarn build); python3 preview_server.py
